duetflow/db.py:363-367 commits only duet_state_meta.written_state after a successful PUT; duet_state and duet_state_meta.initialized stay at their pre-write values until record_refresh succeeds. If the first PUT succeeds but record_refresh fails, duet_state remains empty although Spotify holds the written tracks. On the next Refresh, duetflow/playlist.py:165-175 treats the run as a cold start and skips reconciliation, so a track a person removes after that write is reintroduced and never Vetoed. Observed in the new checkpoint at 4bbc6ce (archived run 3 finding 3, still incomplete for first-write retries). Rule: Every confirmed Spotify write must leave an authoritative persisted written Duet and initialized state before subsequent Refresh logic can run; retries must reconcile human changes against that write, including after the first write.. Scope: The confirmed-write checkpoint in duetflow/db.py and the initialization/reconciliation branch in duetflow/playlist.py for initial and later successful PUTs whose record_refresh bookkeeping fails.. Verify: Make the initial fake Spotify PUT succeed and fail record_refresh once. Immediately assert duet_state represents that successful write and the persisted initialization state is true. Remove one written track by hand, retry Refresh, and assert it becomes a permanent Veto and is not restored; add a new track by hand in a companion case and assert its Pin attribution is captured. Retain the ordinary-rotation retry checks for no self-generated Veto or Pin..

failure.evidence: review changes_requested: After a successful ordinary rotation PUT changes a0 to a1 and record_refresh fails, record_successful_write checkpoints a1 but does not checkpoint the eviction cooldown. With both a0 and a1 still in the Source Playlist and turnover.per_side=1, the next Refresh selects a0 again: I reproduced Spotify and duet_state reverting from a1 to a0, with a cooldown incorrectly created for a1. The newly added retry test avoids this by removing a0 from the eligible Source Playlist. Rule: A confirmed write remains authoritative across a bookkeeping failure: a retry must preserve every generated admission and eviction, including the cooldown needed to prevent the just evicted track from returning, and must not undo the successful write as ordinary turnover.. Scope: Every successful initial or later PUT whose record_refresh fails, for both sides and for writes that also reconcile human Pins or Vetoes; the checkpoint and retry selection in duetflow/db.py and duetflow/playlist.py.. Verify: With target_size=2 and turnover.per_side=1, keep both a0 and a1 eligible in the Source Playlist; start with a0, allow a PUT replacing it with a1, fail record_refresh once, then retry. Assert no Veto for a0 or Pin for a1, a0 stays in cooldown, and Spotify and duet_state still contain a1. Repeat with a captured human Pin in that PUT and assert its attribution and term remain unchanged..
